mapper.sql: EXECUTION_ID AS "executionId" , WORKFLOW_ID AS "workflowId" , CALLER AS "caller" , SESSION_ID AS "sessionId" , STATUS AS "status" , CURRENT_STEP_INDEX AS "currentStepIndex" , CONTEXT_JSON::text AS "contextJson" , RESULT_TEXT AS "resultText" , ERROR_MESSAGE AS "errorMessage" , CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" , UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt" , REQUESTED_BY AS "requestedBy"

EXECUTION_ID AS "executionId" , WORKFLOW_ID AS "workflowId" , CALLER AS "caller" , SESSION_ID AS "sessionId" , STATUS AS "status" , CURRENT_STEP_INDEX AS "currentStepIndex" , ERROR_MESSAGE AS "errorMessage" , CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" , UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt" , REQUESTED_BY AS "requestedBy"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION (EXECUTION_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, CALLER, SESSION_ID, STATUS, CURRENT_STEP_INDEX, CONTEXT_JSON, RESULT_TEXT, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT , REQUESTED_BY, OWNER_INSTANCE, HEARTBEAT_AT) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{workflowId}, #{caller}, #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{currentStepIndex}, CAST(#{contextJson} AS jsonb), #{resultText}, #{errorMessage} , #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} , #{requestedBy}, #{ownerInstance}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION SET PAUSE_REQUESTED = TRUE WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION SET HEARTBEAT_AT = now() WHERE OWNER_INSTANCE = #{ownerInstance} AND STATUS IN ('RUNNING', 'QUEUED')

UPDATE AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION SET STATUS = 'FAILED' , ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage} , PAUSE_REQUESTED = FALSE , UPDATED_AT = now() WHERE STATUS IN ('RUNNING', 'QUEUED') AND (HEARTBEAT_AT IS NULL OR HEARTBEAT_AT < now() - make_interval(secs => #{staleSeconds}))
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION
ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, EXECUTION_ID LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_STEP_HISTORY (EXECUTION_ID, STEP_ID, STEP_TYPE, STEP_REF, SUCCESS, DURATION_MS, OUTPUT_SUMMARY, FAILURE_REASON, EXECUTED_AT) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{stepId}, #{stepType}, #{stepRef}, #{success}, #{durationMs}, #{outputSummary}, #{failureReason}, #{executedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT STEP_ID AS "stepId" , STEP_TYPE AS "stepType" , STEP_REF AS "stepRef" , SUCCESS AS "success" , DURATION_MS AS "durationMs" , OUTPUT_SUMMARY AS "outputSummary" , FAILURE_REASON AS "failureReason" , EXECUTED_AT AS "executedAt" FROM AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_STEP_HISTORY WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} ORDER BY EXECUTED_AT ASC, ID ASC
